title: My Daughter-in-Law Showed the Church My Boyfriend's Mugshot. I Cut Hair 44 Years. Look at His Ears.
description:
At the church coffee hour my daughter-in-law held up her phone, showed everyone a mugshot and said my new boyfriend robbed three widows in Oklahoma. By Monday the whole town had seen it.

She forgot one thing. I cut hair for forty-four years. I have looked at more faces up close than anybody in that county. Stay until the community Thanksgiving dinner, when she put that mugshot up on the big screen.

Did your family ever judge someone you loved before they knew him? Tell me in the comments. I read every one.
